property.name: odps.enabled
property.description: Enable ODPS natural language query service. Set to true to enable the ODPS integration.

property.name: odps.access.id
property.description: Aliyun AccessKey ID for ODPS authentication. Required when odps.enabled is true.

property.name: odps.access.key
property.description: Aliyun AccessKey Secret for ODPS authentication. Required when odps.enabled is true. IMPORTANT: Keep this value secure and do not commit it to version control.

property.name: odps.endpoint
property.description: ODPS service endpoint URL. Default is the public Aliyun ODPS endpoint. For VPC access, use http://service.odps.aliyun-inc.com/api

property.name: odps.project
property.description: ODPS project name to use for queries. Required when odps.enabled is true.
